title: FBI Photo A002
what_is_it: A still photograph (single monochrome image) submitted to AARO by the FBI as a UAP report.
interpretation_warnings: No extractable text in the file — analysis relies entirely on war.gov metadata and a narrative image description.
The narrative description is explicitly non-analytical and must not be read as a finding or conclusion.
Imagery was redacted before submission, so context may be missing.
No date or location provided, making the event impossible to independently verify.
Single-source, unverified observer; the operator could not identify the object.
A dark object in a crosshair reticle is consistent with many mundane explanations and no identification was made.
